title: ListingsItemPatchRequest
description: The request body schema for the `patchListingsItem` operation.

productType.description: The Amazon product type of the listings item.

patches.description: One or more JSON Patch operations to perform on the listings item.

PatchOperation.description: Individual JSON Patch operation for an HTTP PATCH request.

op.description: Type of JSON Patch operation. Supported JSON Patch operations include `add`, `replace`, `merge` and `delete`. Refer to <https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902>.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: The `add` operation adds or replaces the target property.
The `replace` operation adds or replaces the target property.
The `merge` operation merges the target property.
The `delete` operation removes the target property.

path.description: JSON Pointer path of the element to patch. Refer to [JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) for more information.
